message: How about songs that we never did like, despite the acclaim from the masses?  Like "Stairway to Heaven," which was played at every single dance-formal and informal--that I attended in high school back in the 70's.  Oh, how I hated tha song and could never understand the excitement that came over my peers when the band began to play "She's cliyimbiing the stayerrway to hevuhhhhn."
